title: Ordinary portland cement - Specification (Sixth Revision)
scope_text: Sets requirements for ordinary Portland cement used in general construction. It covers the cement’s required characteristics and the checks used to assess its conformity.
keywords: cement, ordinary Portland, OPC, general construction, cement grade, cement specification

title: Portland slag cement - Specification (fifth revision)
scope_text: Covers Portland slag cement made with granulated blast-furnace slag. It specifies product requirements and the tests used to assess the cement.
keywords: cement, Portland slag, PSC, granulated slag, blended cement, cement specification

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification: Part 1 fly Ash Based (Fourth Revision)
scope_text: Covers Portland pozzolana cement made with fly ash. It sets requirements for the product and tests used to check its conformity.
keywords: cement, Portland pozzolana, fly ash, PPC, blended cement, cement specification

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification: Part 2 Calcined Clay Based (Fourth Revision)
scope_text: Covers Portland pozzolana cement made with calcined clay. It sets requirements for the product and tests used to check its conformity.
keywords: cement, Portland pozzolana, calcined clay, PPC, pozzolana, cement specification

title: Composite Cement - Specification
scope_text: Specifies composite cement and the product requirements used to judge its conformity. The BIS record identifies this as a product specification for cement.
keywords: cement, composite cement, blended cement, clinker, supplementary cementitious material, cement specification

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement: Part 1 Determination of Fineness by Dry Sieving (Second Revision)
scope_text: Describes the physical test procedure for determining hydraulic cement fineness by dry sieving. The method gives a consistent measure of fineness for comparing cement samples.
keywords: cement fineness, dry sieving, sieve test, hydraulic cement, physical test

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement: Part 2 Determination of fineness by Blaine air permeability method (Second Revision)
scope_text: Describes how to determine hydraulic cement fineness using the Blaine air-permeability method. It provides a repeatable physical test for assessing cement fineness.
keywords: cement fineness, Blaine test, air permeability, hydraulic cement, physical test

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement: Part 3 Determination of Soundness (First Revision)
scope_text: Describes the physical test procedure for determining the soundness of hydraulic cement. The procedure supports a consistent assessment of this physical property.
keywords: cement soundness, hydraulic cement, soundness test, physical test, cement testing

title: Methods of Sampling Hydraulic Cement (First revision)
scope_text: Describes sampling methods for hydraulic cement so that a sample can be taken for testing. The guidance is intended to provide a representative sample for subsequent checks.
keywords: cement sampling, hydraulic cement, sample collection, cement testing, sampling method

title: Standard sand for testing cement - Specification (Second Revision)
scope_text: Specifies standard sand used in cement testing. It supports consistent preparation and testing of cement mortar specimens. Standardized sand helps make test results comparable.
keywords: standard sand, cement testing, cement mortar, laboratory sand, mortar test

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope_text: Covers high-strength deformed steel bars and wires used to reinforce concrete. It sets the product requirements and specification framework for reinforcement steel supplied for concrete work.
keywords: TMT bars, high strength deformed bars, reinforcement steel, concrete reinforcement, steel wires, rebar specification

title: High Strength Deformed Stainless Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
scope_text: Specifies high-strength deformed stainless-steel bars and wires intended for concrete reinforcement. It provides the product specification for stainless reinforcement where corrosion resistance and reinforcement performance are required.
keywords: stainless steel rebar, stainless reinforcement bars, high strength steel wires, concrete reinforcement, corrosion resistant rebar, deformed bars

title: Continuous hot-dip galvanized steel bars for concrete reinforcement - Specification
scope_text: Specifies continuously hot-dip galvanized steel bars intended for concrete reinforcement. The specification addresses this coated reinforcement product for use where a zinc coating is part of the corrosion-protection approach.
keywords: galvanized steel bars, hot dip galvanized rebar, zinc coated reinforcement, concrete reinforcement bars, corrosion protection, TMT coating

title: Reinforcement Couplers for Mechanical Splices of Steel Bars in Concrete - Specification (First Revision)
scope_text: Covers couplers used to make mechanical splices between steel reinforcement bars in concrete. It specifies the reinforcement-coupler product rather than the bar itself, supporting continuity of reinforcing steel in concrete construction.
keywords: rebar couplers, reinforcement couplers, mechanical splice, steel bar coupler, concrete rebar connection, TMT bar splice

title: Fusion Bonded Epoxy Coated Reinforcing Bars - Specification
scope_text: Specifies reinforcing bars with a fusion-bonded epoxy coating for use in concrete reinforcement. It sets the product specification for this coated bar type, including the coating-focused requirements presented by the BIS record.
keywords: epoxy coated rebar, fusion bonded coating, corrosion resistant reinforcement, concrete reinforcing bars, coated steel bars, rebar specification

title: Mechanical testing of metals - Tensile Testing
scope_text: Describes tensile testing of metal specimens to obtain mechanical test results. It is used as a test-method reference for evaluating steel and reinforcement products.

title: Hot - Dip Zinc Coating on Structural Steel Bars for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
scope_text: Specifies hot-dip zinc coating requirements for structural steel bars used as concrete reinforcement. It provides a coating specification relevant to galvanized reinforcement bars.
keywords: hot dip zinc coating, galvanized rebar, zinc coated steel bars, reinforcement coating, structural steel coating, corrosion protection

title: Random sampling and randomization procedures (First Revision)
scope_text: Describes random sampling and randomization procedures for obtaining representative selections. It can support sampling plans used when checking steel reinforcement or coupler lots.

title: Method for Knoop hardness testing of metals

scope_text: Covered hot-rolled mild, medium-tensile and high-yield-strength deformed bars for concrete reinforcement. The BIS record identifies this specification as withdrawn and superseded by IS 1786.

title: Polyvinyl chloride insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords with rigid and flexible conductor for rated voltages up to and including 1 100 V (Fourth Revision)

scope_text: Specifies XLPE-insulated, thermoplastic-sheathed cables for working voltages from 3.3 kV through 33 kV. It covers medium-voltage cable construction and performance requirements.

title: Cross - Linked polyethylene insulated thermoplastic sheathed cables - Specification: Part 3 for working voltages from 66 kV up to and including 220 kV
scope_text: Specifies XLPE-insulated, thermoplastic-sheathed cables for working voltages from 66 kV through 220 kV. It addresses the product requirements for these high-voltage cables.

title: Specification for PVC insulation and sheath of electric cables (First Revision)
scope_text: Specifies PVC insulation and sheath materials used for electric cables. It provides material requirements supporting cable manufacture and qualification.

title: Methods of test for cables: Part 5 conductor resistance test
scope_text: Describes the conductor-resistance test used for electric cables. It supports verification of electrical conductor performance.

title: Methods of test for cables: Part 53 flammability test
scope_text: Describes the flammability test used for electric cables. It supports assessment of cable behaviour when exposed to a specified flame test.

title: Electrotechnical Vocabulary Part 32 Electric Cables ( Second Revision )
scope_text: Provides terminology for electric cables and related electrotechnical concepts. It supports consistent use of cable terms in specifications and testing.
